title: StreamConfig
description: Contains configuration for streaming FHIR export.

resourceTypes.description: Optional. Supply a FHIR resource type (such as "Patient" or "Observation"). See https://www.hl7.org/fhir/valueset-resource-types.html for a list of all FHIR resource types. The server treats an empty list as an intent to stream all the supported resource types in this FHIR store.
